_about: Public-domain Charles Chauncy (1705-1787), pastor of the First Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: his sermons against the excesses of the Great Awakening and his Seasonable Thoughts (1743), his writings against an American episcopate (1762-1771), his later sermons and the Five Dissertations on the Fall (1785), from Internet Archive scans of the first printings and two early reprints. Chauncy was the leading Old Light opponent of Whitefield and Edwards, and his last books taught universal salvation; he is shelved as part of the record. His anonymous books are held as pending. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
